## Security

Maestro runs with the user's rights, beside their sign-ins. Tick what applies. See [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

- [ ] This change starts no new program, opens no new connection, adds no crate and adds no `unsafe` code.
- [ ] It does one of those, I have said which and why above, and I updated the list in `src/guard.rs`.
- [ ] It reads no file that holds a sign-in or key, and writes no key to disk, a log or the screen.
- [ ] Text from outside the program (folder names, program names, anything an agent wrote) is not put into a command line.
